title: Synergistic drug combinations and machine learning for drug repurposing in chordoma.
summary: Models ranked repurposing assets; AZD2014 inhibited chordoma cells. Separate drug-combination synergy is not automatically attributable to AI; no clinical efficacy is shown.
organization: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Collaborations Pharmaceuticals (United States); RTI International

evidence.tested: Models ranked repurposing assets; AZD2014 inhibited chordoma cells. Separate drug-combination synergy is not automatically attributable to AI; no clinical efficacy is shown.
